decisions.reason: Low-cost extension of core secure communication keeps its option value open, so we keep it despite unresolved market uncertainty.
Digital signature remains an adjacent low-cost option that can build on existing authentication know-how, so we keep it while uncertainty persists.
As a foundational security architecture, its strategic option value across multiple future offerings justifies keeping the low-cost option open.
The email-to-app robot is peripheral and costly to maintain, and after two more years without market traction its option value is too low to justify keeping.
Hardware token inventory and support costs are high, and with no observed market presence the option is no longer worth keeping.
Regulatory demand for payment compliance keeps this a valuable low-cost option aligned with the firm's security suite, so we keep it.
